scripts.lint: npm run api:types && npm run lint:contract
scripts.build: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_SEND_ERROR_REPORTS=false WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist --metafile dist/meta.json
scripts.api:types: npm run generate && git diff --exit-code src/generated/
scripts.generate: openapi-typescript ../../specs/005-v1-api/openapi.yaml -o src/generated/api.ts && REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly bundle ../../specs/005-v1-api/openapi.yaml --ext json -o src/generated/openapi.json && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler types src/generated/worker-configuration.d.ts --env-file .dev.vars.example --strict-vars=false
